subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For UUID-like Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys, should OpenClaw route users away from `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`, keep the current split with clearer diagnostics, or treat this as unsupported configuration?
rationale: Source inspection shows a plausible current mismatch, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can decide the intended vendor contract and whether changing routing/defaults would be safe for existing Volcengine users.

options.title: Live-verify and fix plugin behavior
options.body: Use a real Lite/Coding Plan key to compare the general and coding endpoints, then update the Volcengine plugin, docs, and tests for the confirmed route or diagnostic.

options.title: Document unsupported pairing
options.body: If the Lite key is not meant to work with the general DeepSeek row, keep runtime behavior and add setup/runtime guidance that points users to the Coding Plan model rows.

options.title: Defer pending vendor proof
options.body: Leave the issue open with `needs-live-repro` until a reporter or maintainer can provide redacted live output for both endpoint families.

recommendation.title: Live-verify and fix plugin behavior
recommendation.body: Use a real Lite/Coding Plan key to compare the general and coding endpoints, then update the Volcengine plugin, docs, and tests for the confirmed route or diagnostic.
